blocks.html: Mactan, Cebu | June-July 2025 Dusit Thani Mactan Cebu proudly announces its inclusion in the prestigious Michelin Guide Recommended Hotel List in the Philippines, solidifying its status as a premier luxury destination. This international recognition comes alongside its remarkable win as #1 Best Beach, Island & Upcountry Resort at the Travel + Leisure Awards 2025, a testament to the resort’s unwavering commitment to exceptional hospitality, culinary excellence, and world-class guest experiences.

Renowned for its seamless blend of Thai graciousness and Visayan warmth, Dusit Thani Mactan Cebu delivers exceptional 5-star hospitality. With a breathtaking infinity pool, diverse dining experiences, well-appointed accommodations, versatile event spaces, and a full suite of wellness amenities, the resort is celebrated as a holistic tropical haven for discerning travelers from Cebu and beyond.

Committed to world-class hospitality, Dusit Thani Mactan Cebu features a variety of rooms and suites designed for both business and leisure travelers, each with modern amenities, ensuite bathrooms, and private balconies showcasing stunning ocean or city views. Guests enjoy a luxurious stay that blends Thai elegance with warm Filipino hospitality.

Dusit Thani Mactan Cebu elevates its culinary offerings with a curated selection of dining experiences. Home to Benjarong, the island’s exclusive Thai fine dining restaurant, guests can savor authentic Thai cuisine, indulge in international and local favorites at Tradewinds Café—highlighted by the popular Saturday Seafood Night Market—or enjoy reimagined Filipino comfort food at the Sunset Sports Bar Completing the dining experience, The View provides a sophisticated setting for guests to enjoy refreshing drinks while taking in the picturesque al fresco views of Magellan Bay.

Dusit Thani Mactan Cebu also offers elegant and flexible event spaces, headlined by the grand, pillarless Dusit Ballroom—ideal for high-level conferences, weddings, and social gatherings. Designed with sophistication and supported by impeccable service, the venue seamlessly blends style and function.
The hotel also offers a sanctuary of holistic wellness, Namm Spa, guiding guests through personalized treatments that rejuvenate body, mind, and spirit for a truly bespoke experience.

Fueled by a commitment to world-class hospitality, Dusit Thani Mactan Cebu continues to set the standard for luxury in the region. At the helm, General Manager Mr. Laurent Betourne leads the team in elevating the resort’s vision and strengthening its position as one of the Philippines’ premier luxury destinations.
For bookings and enquiries, please visit www.dusit.com/dusitthani-mactancebu
